Royal Churches

Basilica of Saint-Denis – The burial place of the Kings of France, with nearly every king from the 10th to the 18th centuries buried there; Photo Credit – © Susan Flantzer

Churches, whether small chapels or large cathedrals, have played important roles in the lives of European royalty for centuries. Some were used for personal prayer and contemplation, while others witnessed christenings, weddings, coronations, funerals, and burials.
